reviews.review: If you have also gone 10 years without playing this game for no good reason, cut that out today. This game frickin' rules and you can have such a custom experience depending on your play style. Some people spend countless hours fishing and have various spots that they camp at for the day to do just that! I am not those people. I yearn for the mines, and luckily there's plenty of mining opportunities to unlock and explore. You can also forage, farm, fight, and fu-, I mean find love. Or a platonic eldritch roommate. The choice is all yours! I rarely review games, but after spending over 9 full days playing this game in the span of 2 months with a full time job, ConcernedApe has definitely earned the time it took to write this review. Looking forward to 1.7!

Even if you've maybe gotten married, had kids, all of that stuff in just one save file, you can just make a new save file and this time, do it all again, but with a different person and different interactions. The only bad thing I have left to say about this game is probably that it NEEDS voice actors, though there are already mods for it. I know I'm late by like.. 10 years, but I couldn't care less, I just really enjoy the game.

A relaxing game that works well on my non-gaming laptop, with a pixel-based look that is actually pretty satisfying. Love how I can just raise my animals and harvest my crops without an annoying overarching story I'm forced to play through. And I love how it cycles through the seasons so every so often the vibe of the game shifts. It's easy to generate coins and level up, and I appreciate how you can buy most resources instead of having to harvest/find everything. Often, I do have to look up things on the internet - Store Hours, how to fish properly, how certain things work - but I like how the gameplay is simple while the details are well thought through. Overall, as someone who lives in the city, can't yet afford land/a house of my own, and where it is currently cold and miserable, this game is a nice escape and one of the only things the actually relaxes me <3

For people who are looking to be creative in a very relaxing environment.

The progression can be very slow, but in some ways its good because that means even after hundreds of hours, there are things you haven't unlocked.

The side quests aren't all clear, but they do make the game more challenging. You need to learn what NPC's like to befriend them (or marry them), which is fun. 

The storyline wasn't really all that important, felt like it was something added just to give context on why your character is on a farm. (which is fair I guess, but still could have been more story related events imo)

The different seasons really make this game what it is. The mechanic of needing to go to sleep and the days progressing make you learn how important every minute of your day is. Did I replant all my crops? Did I visit all the NPC's I needed? When's the next town event? 

Definitely more of a relaxing game, but that doesn't mean its not challenging. If you're someone who struggles to manage their time and someone who puts random items in random chests when playing minecraft, you will definitely struggle here. Still worth the play.

First off I want to start out by saying this game was fantastic. It has a sort of laid-back fun atmosphere where you can kind of do what you want whenever you want. The events are interesting, especially the desert festival. The characters all have their distinct personalities and it was hard for me to choose a marriage candidate as they are all so great in their own way.

Now how I played this game was anything but laid-back and relaxed. Min-maxing became a hard chore to get as much out of every day as possible. 100%-ing the game in less than 150 hours was no simple task. It started to get a bit tedious towards the end of my run, as I was just looking to beat the game and not really sitting back and enjoying it for what it was. 

Overall I really enjoyed the game, but would say for anybody like me who has to min-max and tries to be as effective as possible to just be wary of this game.

Stardew Valley is a beautiful, wholesome masterpiece that captures the spirit of its inspirations, but stands tall on its own as a household name; an embellished slice of life we'd all be better off pursuing. Even for a farming/life sim, you've got a great deal of freedom of choice!
Farm, forage, fish, mine, explore, get your butt handed to you by the denizens of the abandoned mines; meet, befriend, and even marry the inhabitants of Pelican Town, and start a family. I'm not gonna spoil the optional story paths from here on out, but you can also rebuild the Pelican Town Community Center, or support the soulless Joja corporation in building a warehouse in its place.
I've chosen the townsfolk and their community center in EVERY SINGLE playthrough. I know you'll do the same.

This game, is just, unabashedly, one of the best 'cozy farming games' out there. Like, straight up. There's a reason that every new cozy game is trying to copy this one. Firstly, ConcernedApe made this game entirely on their own. That shit is so goated-

Sorry, secondly, this game has so much you get to do. If you don't like one aspect, try another. There's so many ways to make money and find enjoyment out of this. If you don't like mining, just don't mine. If you hate fishing with a burning passion, that's real! Go back to the farm. There are animals. You have pets and cattle and you can pet the animals.......... There's complexities like the seasons with different main crops and there's different sell prices and who doesn't love automation and such???

I'm just saying, if you loved the slime market from the slime rancher series you will LOVE selling stuff in this game. It is so fun getting into the numbers and how to maximize profits.

Not to mention, if you DON'T like something, this game has some of the easiest modding mechanics I've seen for a game besides, like, rain world or something. This game is only beaten out by 'subscribe to item on steam workshop'. THAT'S how easy!! If you hate fishing with a burning passion! You can make fishing easier! In many ways!!!!!!! There are MULTIPLE WAYS TO MAKE FISHING REDUNDANT! HOW COOL IS THAT-

Okay, I might REALLY like this game. But like......... You'll see why.........................

Any gripe you have with this game, can probably be solved by the modding community. They are some of the craziest of the modding communities I have seen for games. And that's assuming you even find a gripe to begin with, because gosh there is just so much to love about Stardew Valley...

AND IT WAS MADE BY ONE PERSON???????????????????????
